policy.text: CER and exact sentences follow the frozen benchmark, including numeral spelling differences.
policy.keyword: Ordered exact tokens per reference-positive clip, extra tokens on reference-negative clips listed separately; lexical direction, negation/stop, motion and quantity pairs follow the frozen anchor list.
policy.number: Separate supplementary whole-clip numeral sequence, including non-length counts and times; unify Chinese and Arabic spellings, treat 千克 as the unit kg and exclude lexical 一 in 一定, 一起, 一直, 统一. A numeral is still counted when its unit is missing.
policy.length_unit: Separate supplementary whole-clip millimetre, centimetre and metre unit sequence; centimetre spellings are equivalent. A bare 米 requires a preceding numeral. These automatic views do not replace semantic review.
policy.time: Sum of per-clip wall times after model load, with no new warmup or inference passes. RTF divides this sum by the clips' total audio duration.

comparison.split_note: All 24 clips come from AISHELL-1 train. Evaluation is the project's speaker-held-out subset, not the official AISHELL-1 test split.
comparison.timing_note: SenseVoice wall time includes audio decode after one model load, no warm-up. Whisper timings are earlier runs on this computer, not a randomized concurrent speed comparison.
